name: Haus Beer Nebenhaus
beschreibung: Haus Beer Nebenhaus is an inn in Ellmau, Tirol. The accommodation is located in the town center and offers simple guest rooms. The attached restaurant serves regional dishes. The furnishings are functional and geared toward the basic needs of travelers. Several hiking trails start from the house and lead into the surrounding mountains. The inn is suitable for guests looking for affordable accommodation. The building is built in a traditional style and blends into the townscape.
